description: One erasure of persons' details from a register book's past entries, by the book's count role once the law's retention has passed (Erase persons' details on the book). It names who, when, the retention in force, the shop's own destruction record and every entry and column erased. Never changed or deleted.

fields.description: The act erased what was due among the entries entered up to this day.
fields.label: Entered up to

fields.description: The book's retention when the act ran: each erased entry had been kept whole at least this long.
fields.label: Retention (years)

fields.description: The shop's own record of the destruction the law asks for: the committee's minutes, the inspector who was present.
fields.label: The market's destruction record

fields.description: Entries written before a person's details could be erased from a line: they keep them.
fields.label: Entries kept whole

fields.description: The erased entries as the printed book numbers them (per item, where each item numbers from 1).
fields.label: Entry numbers

fields.description: Each erased entry (its line) and the columns erased from it. Verify book checks every erased column against this list.
fields.label: Entries and columns

lede: A record that a person's details were erased from a register book after its retention.
name: Retail Register Erasure
written_elsewhere: iVendNext writes it when a person's details are erased.
